_comment: Production-equivalent scale for the #615 rehearsal baseline.
The two affected tables are the only ones that receive scale data, because
they are the only ones 20261006100000 locks and rewrites:
email_address_state    ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN is_suppressed ... STORED  (full rewrite)
email_delivery_events  DROP/ADD CHECK constraint                            (full validation scan)
plus the backfill, whose cost follows the state/event-type distribution below.
source MUST be 'measured' before clone-build-baseline will run. Invented
numbers produce an invented timing result, so the tooling refuses them.
Fill these from a READ-ONLY production sizing query (see ADR-001 §7).
